revenue_scope: Worldwide (US + Intl) combined darunavir-containing line: 'PREZISTA / PREZCOBIX' (2015Q1, Q2), 'PREZISTA / PREZCOBIX / REZOLSTA' (2015Q3-2017Q3), 'PREZISTA / PREZCOBIX / REZOLSTA / SYMTUZA' (2017Q4 on).
why_separate: The gold series is PREZISTA alone, last printed for 2014Q4. From 2015Q1 J&J prints only a combined line that adds PREZCOBIX, then REZOLSTA, then SYMTUZA, so it holds more than Prezista's own sales.
notes: Span 2015Q1-2026Q2, each quarter read from its own schedule as current; the row label changes as products join, dated by the headings (PREZCOBIX from the 2015Q1 schedule, REZOLSTA from 2015Q3, SYMTUZA from 2017Q4). The 2015Q1 schedule's prior-year figure (2014Q1) is 445, equal to the PREZISTA-only 2014Q1 row of the gold series, so the first two quarters differ from Prezista alone only by PREZCOBIX. 2015Q3 is read from the 2016Q3 schedule's prior-year column (468) because the 2015Q3 PDF text splits the digits ('4 68'); the value is the same quarter's figure. J&J's schedules print no separate PREZCOBIX, REZOLSTA or SYMTUZA line (the sibling gold exclusions record PREZCOBIX and SYMTUZA as not reported separately); Gilead's revenue share on Symtuza is a different measure and was not used. Annual checks: each Q4 schedule's twelve-month figure equals the sum of that year's four rows (2015 1,810; 2016 1,851; 2017 1,821; 2018 1,955; 2019 2,110; 2020 2,184; 2021 2,083; 2022 1,943; 2023 1,854; 2024 1,712; 2025 1,579).

Fetched each J&J schedule row from the document's own text: the first occurrence of the line's name line followed by its WW row (the main Reported Sales vs. Prior Period table, ahead of any supplemental table).

Searched the 49 schedule PDFs for PREZISTA: PREZISTA-only line through 2014Q4; 'PREZISTA / PREZCOBIX' 2015Q1-Q2; with REZOLSTA 2015Q3-2017Q3; with SYMTUZA 2017Q4-2026Q2. No PREZISTA-only row after 2014Q4 in any schedule.
Compared the 2015Q1 schedule's prior-year column with the gold row for 2014Q1 (445 = 445).
Partner rung: Gilead's Symtuza and Rezolsta partners print a revenue share, not net sales of darunavir; no other issuer prints PREZISTA net sales.
